footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Highwoods: after $5.4M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 2.4% to $806M in 2025. Operating income rose 31.0% to $308M, a 38.2% margin.
Net income rose 57.6% to $157M, or $1.45 per share. Operating cash flow was $359M and free cash flow $359M, versus $404M; Highwoods returned $217M through dividends.
sources: Highwoods Properties, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
